note: A server-controlled MQTT v5 property node is allocated and linked into the decoded property list.
The code must not free a property list that is still owned by the caller or will be freed again later; the safety obligation is that free_props stays false for borrowed lists.
CONNECT-ACK decoding passes the decoded property list to Handle_Props with free_props=1, triggering the invalid free path in MqttProps_Free.
